verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an expiration_date field: once that date passes, a memory stops surfacing in search but is not deleted. This gives a manually set 'valid until' cutoff that separates current from expired facts. There is no evidence of true temporal reasoning, such as recording when a fact became valid or automatically invalidating facts that are superseded or contradicted. Missing for 10: valid-from/valid-to timestamps on facts or graph edges, automatic invalidation of outdated facts when new information conflicts, point-in-time (as-of) queries over memory history, independent or hands-on corroboration.
